gate: E-process arms irreversibly exclude at first exact rational LR>=324000; naive arm at first observed equality. All arms retain log-LRpaths and first crossings. Fixed exponential exposure factor8/9, no eta/q1 tuning.
primary_hypothesis: At fixedN1500,exponential exposure acquisition with e-process exclusion improves mean heldout solved accuracy by at least10percentagepoints over uniform acquisition with the same e-process estimator,under independent1percent queried-label corruption.
primary_effect: Paired mean accuracy exponential_e minus uniform_e in percentagepoints,across32independent source-bank/noise/tie/search-seed repetitions on the same10000fresh test puzzles.
primary_interval: 5000paired two-way bootstrap resamples of32banks and10000shared puzzleindices,RNG20270000. Percentile95percent interval. Supported if lower>=10pp; falsified if upper<10pp; otherwise inconclusive. No adaptive extension.
uncertainty_limit: 32independent source-bank draws,one independent noise and tie stream perbank,and32paired search seeds. The same10000testinputs repeat acrossbanks. Bootstrap uncertainty is approximate,not a population-universal acquisition guarantee.
registration_rule: Full study and sampling protocols freeze before input generation. After preparation, an immutable registration records the input manifest SHA256 and unchanged study protocol SHA256 before acquisition. Runners resolve the manifest hash from that registration; no outcomes are available during registration.
noise: For bank s,NumPy2.3.4 RNG20268000+s draws81Bernoulli(.01)potentialflips then81uniform int8 offsets1..8 each row. Potential noisy labels are(clean+flip*offset)%9,shared across policies. All three masks finalize before any current-row noisy label is exposed. Source/tie/noise RNG ranges are disjoint.
ties: NumPy2.3.4 default_rng(20267000+s),one shared81permutation perrow. Same greedy tie rule; no noise-value access.
acquisition_interface: Policy gets only past joint counts,irreversible past exclusions,k25,and tie permutation. Full100percent-complete stored labels are a simulated oracle; policy receives only25noisyquerieddigits each row. No current values,sourceidentity,geometry or oracle handle enters the policy.
gates: Independent exact masks reconstructed from past noisy queriedarchives; allcurrent masks finalize before reveals; noise draws,logLRpaths,exact rational crossings,and prefix supports independently replayed. Row-noise independence and predictable masks are required by the proof.
secondary: Structural missing/extra edges,permodel true-edge retention,and naive-first-equality performance/wrong stops are secondary. Other accuracycontrasts use descriptive unadjusted paired two-way95percent intervals. No empirical zero-missing result is substituted for the theorem.
budget: At most30GPU-minutes including trajectory preflight. Exact support/settings/search-seed/input deduplication. No duplicate/filler jobs.
relation_to_prior: N1500selected using a separately labeled six-old-bank structural feasibility grid. Old pilot is not pooled; fresh inputs exclude all260724previous unique source rows.
stopping_rule: Exactly32freshindependent1500-boardbanks,threefixedpolicies,96requestedN1500inferencecells except exactdedup. No tuning eta,q1,querycount,rate,primarymargin,or search configuration.
limitations: Stored100percentcompleteboards simulate a query oracle; only25noisylabelsperrow reach each policy.
The known independent noise law is supplied,not learned. Misspecification is outside the deletion theorem.
Ville+union guarantees at most1percent probability of deleting any trueedge per learned e-process model,not one global1percent event acrossallbanks/arms.
Deletion protection does not bound falseextraedges,exactrecovery,solveaccuracy,or arbitrary learned-model stopping certificates.
Naive first-equality pruning has no deletion guarantee; wrong stops must be measured and retained.
BP AdamW is outside this acquisition/robust-count mechanism study and not run.
Cross-bank source overlap is allowed by independent sampling; distinct sourceboards are reported.
